title: Attention Is All You Need for Chinese Word Segmentation

answer_short: Chinese word segmentation (CWS) is a task in Chinese natural language processing to identify word boundaries, as Chinese lacks explicit delimiters. It is often modeled as a sequence labeling task using neural networks, Markov models, or CRF, with encoders (like RNN, LSTM, CNN) and decoders (like Viterbi or graph-based models) to generate effective representations and segment words.
